articles.title_en: Temporary Layoffs, Firm Entry and Exit Dynamics, and Aggregate Fluctuations
articles.title_cn: 临时裁员、企业进入与退出动态及总体波动
articles.abstract_en: We build a model to study how the countercyclicality of temporary layoffs affects unemployment, firm entry and exit, and macroeconomic fluctuations. The model can quantitatively generate the rich cyclical dynamics of temporary layoffs, unemployment, and firms in US data. The cyclicality of temporary layoffs plays a key role in limiting the contraction in job creation and the rise in unemployment during recessions. Amid factual wage dynamics, the countercyclical buffer from temporary layoffs extends beyond the labor market and contributes to shallower contractions in the number of firms and GDP, but has little influence on the pace of recoveries. (JEL E23, E24, E32, J23, J63)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个模型来研究临时裁员的逆周期性如何影响失业、企业进入与退出以及宏观经济波动。该模型能够定量地再现美国数据中临时裁员、失业和企业丰富的周期性动态。临时裁员的周期性在限制经济衰退期间就业创造收缩和失业上升方面发挥着关键作用。在实际工资动态背景下，来自临时裁员的逆周期缓冲作用超出了劳动力市场，有助于减缓企业数量和GDP的收缩幅度，但对复苏步伐影响甚微。(JEL E23, E24, E32, J23, J63)

articles.title_en: The Dynamics of Development: Innovation and Reallocation
articles.title_cn: 发展的动态：创新与再配置
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a quantitative model of endogenous firm dynamics to study growth-acceleration episodes triggered by reforms. We find that reversals of entry distortions lead to persistent growth in TFP and declining average firm size, as in the experience of successful postcommunist transitions. Removing idiosyncratic distortions results in a more protracted path of TFP and a rising average firm size, as in noncommunist growth accelerations. When calibrating the reforms to China's liberalization, we find that the model accounts for one-third of the observed growth in TFP while matching the dynamics of average firm size and income inequality. (JEL D22, H25, L25, O14, O31, P24, P31)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个内生企业动态的定量模型，用以研究由改革引发的增长加速阶段。我们发现，进入扭曲的逆转会导致全要素生产率的持续增长和平均企业规模的下降，正如成功的后共产主义转型经验所示。消除特质性扭曲则导致全要素生产率更为持久的增长路径和平均企业规模的上升，如同非共产主义增长加速期的情况。当将改革校准到中国的自由化时，我们发现该模型解释了观察到的全要素生产率增长的三分之一，同时匹配了平均企业规模和收入不平等的动态。(JEL D22, H25, L25, O14, O31, P24, P31)

articles.title_en: The Consumption Origins of Business Cycles: Lessons from Sectoral Dynamics
articles.title_cn: 商业周期的消费起源：来自部门动态的启示
articles.abstract_en: We measure the impact of household consumption shocks on aggregate fluctuations. These shocks affect household consumption directly, and production and prices indirectly through their impact on aggregate consumption. We show how to identify such shocks using prior knowledge of their differential impact across sectoral variables. Shocks independently affecting household consumption demand have accounted for around 40 percent of business cycle fluctuations since the mid-1970s, playing a central role in recessions within that period. The inferred household consumption shock series correlates well with measures of changes in consumer confidence and household wealth. (JEL D12, E21, E23, E32, G51)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们衡量家庭消费冲击对总体波动的影响。这些冲击直接影响家庭消费，并通过其对总消费的影响间接影响生产和价格。我们展示了如何利用这些冲击对部门变量的差异性影响的先验知识来识别此类冲击。自1970年代中期以来，独立影响家庭消费需求的冲击约占商业周期波动的40%，在该时期的衰退中发挥了核心作用。推断出的家庭消费冲击序列与消费者信心和家庭财富变化的衡量指标密切相关。(JEL D12, E21, E23, E32, G51)

articles.abstract_en: I explore the business-cycle implications of household inattention to savings product choices. In a model with heterogeneous banks, savers pay more attention to their bank choice when the marginal utility of income is high. Consistent with this, in data from the United Kingdom retail savings market, I find savers more reliably choose products closer to the top of the available interest rate distribution during contractions. Countercyclical attention amplifies shocks to consumption: after contractionary shocks, attention rises, so savers experience higher interest rates, which further reduces consumption. In a quantitative New Keynesian model, this amplification increases the variance of consumption by 13.6 percent. (JEL E12, E32, E43, E71, G21, G51)
articles.abstract_cn: 我探讨了家庭对储蓄产品选择关注不足的商业周期影响。在一个拥有异质性银行的模型中，当收入边际效用高时，储户会更加关注其银行选择。与此一致，在英国零售储蓄市场的数据中，我发现储户在经济收缩期间更可靠地选择接近可用利率分布顶端的产品。反周期关注放大了对消费的冲击：在收缩性冲击后，关注度上升，因此储户经历更高的利率，这进一步减少了消费。在一个定量新凯恩斯模型中，这种放大效应使消费的方差增加了13.6%。(JEL E12, E32, E43, E71, G21, G51)

articles.title_en: The Impact of Unemployment Benefit Extensions on Employment: The 2014 Employment Miracle?
articles.title_cn: 失业救济金延长对就业的影响：2014年就业奇迹？
articles.abstract_en: We measure the aggregate effect of unemployment benefit duration on employment and the labor force. We exploit the variation induced by Congress' failure in December 2013 to reauthorize the unprecedented benefit extensions introduced during the Great Recession. Federal benefit extensions that ranged from 0 to 47 weeks across US states were abruptly cut to zero. In sharp contrast to their typical dynamics, labor force and employment growth accelerated sharply in states with larger cuts in benefit duration. These findings are consistent with the equilibrium search framework that assigns an important role to endogenous job creation. (JEL E24, E32, J21, J64, J65)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们衡量了失业救济金领取期限对就业和劳动力总量的总体影响。我们利用了国会在十二月2013年未能重新授权大衰退期间引入的前所未有的救济金延长的变化。美国各州联邦救济金延长从0到47周不等，被突然削减至零。与通常的动态形成鲜明对比的是，在救济金期限削减幅度较大的州，劳动力增长和就业增长急剧加速。这些发现与均衡搜索框架一致，该框架赋予内生就业创造重要作用。（JEL E24, E32, J21, J64, J65）

articles.title_en: Real Exchange Rates and Endogenous Productivity
articles.title_cn: 实际汇率与内生生产率
articles.abstract_en: Two-thirds of the real exchange rate's (RER's) volatility occurs at low frequencies. We provide empirical evidence that links movements in the RER to changes in research and development spending and patents. A two-country real business cycle model with endogenous productivity and a gradual dissemination of ideas can rationalize these facts. Endogenous productivity alters RER dynamics by inducing (i) a persistent gap in productivity between countries and (ii) a reallocation of resources toward research and development spending. The estimated full model effortlessly replicates the dynamic properties of the RER at all horizons without sacrificing the model's fit along other dimensions. (JEL E13, E32, F31, F43, F44)
articles.abstract_cn: 实际汇率（RER）波动的三分之二发生在低频部分。我们提供了实证证据，将实际汇率的变动与研发支出和专利的变化联系起来。一个包含内生生产率和思想逐步传播的两国实际商业周期模型能够合理化这些事实。内生生产率通过诱导（i）国家间生产率的持续差距和（ii）资源向研发支出的重新分配来改变实际汇率的动态。估计的完整模型在不牺牲模型在其他维度拟合度的前提下，轻松复制了实际汇率在所有时间范围内的动态特性。（JEL E13, E32, F31, F43, F44）

articles.title_en: Time to Say Goodbye: The Macroeconomic Implications of Termination Notice
articles.title_cn: 该说再见了：解雇通知的宏观经济影响
articles.abstract_en: Insuring households against unemployment risk is a cornerstone of modern economic policy. Many countries provide unemployment insurance partly by employment protection mandates, most commonly using termination notice mandates. Unlike unemployment insurance benefits, termination notices can stimulate search effort by the unemployed. I formalize this idea using a calibrated heterogeneous agents model, show how termination notice alters the incentives of firms and workers, and study the insurance role of a termination notice in general equilibrium. I demonstrate how termination notice mandates and unemployment insurance benefits are complementary policies. Finally, I also compare termination notice and severance pay. (JEL D31, D52, E24, J23, J64, J65)
articles.abstract_cn: 为家庭提供失业风险保障是现代经济政策的基石。许多国家通过就业保护规定，最常见的是解雇通知规定，部分提供失业保险。与失业保险福利不同，解雇通知可以刺激失业者的求职努力。我使用校准的异质性主体模型形式化了这一想法，展示了解雇通知如何改变企业和工人的激励，并在一般均衡中研究了解雇通知的保险作用。我证明了解雇通知规定和失业保险福利是互补的政策。最后，我还比较了解雇通知和遣散费。(JEL D31, D52, E24, J23, J64, J65)

articles.title_en: GDP-B: Accounting for the Value of New and Free Goods
articles.title_cn: GDP-B：新商品和免费商品价值的核算
articles.abstract_en: The welfare contributions of new goods and free goods are not well-measured in standard statistical agency metrics like GDP or productivity. We derive explicit terms for the contributions of these goods and introduce a new framework and metric, GDP-B, which quantifies their benefits. We apply this framework to several empirical examples, including Facebook and smartphone cameras, and estimate their valuations through incentive-compatible choice experiments. Our new approach can help measure welfare changes over time and reveal which goods and innovations contribute the most to economic growth and well-being. (JEL D13, E01, E23, O30)
articles.abstract_cn: 新商品和免费商品的福利贡献在标准统计机构指标（如GDP或生产率）中未被充分衡量。我们推导了这些商品贡献的明确项，并引入了一个新框架和指标GDP-B，用以量化其收益。我们将此框架应用于多个实证案例，包括Facebook和智能手机摄像头，并通过激励相容的选择实验估计其价值。我们的新方法有助于衡量随时间变化的福利，并揭示哪些商品和创新对经济增长和福祉贡献最大。（JEL D13, E01, E23, O30）

articles.title_en: Changing Business Cycles: The Role of Women's Employment
articles.title_cn: 变化的商业周期：女性就业的作用
articles.abstract_en: Women's labor force participation in the United States rose rapidly until the mid-1990s when it flattened out. I examine the impact of this change in trend on aggregate business cycles with a quantitative model that incorporates gender differences. I show that the rise in women's participation played a substantial role in the Great Moderation and not allowing for gender differences leads to incorrect inference on its causes. The subsequent slowdown in women's participation played a substantial role in jobless recoveries and reduced aggregate hours and output growth in expansions, worsening aggregate economic performance in the United States. (JEL E13, E23, E24, E32, J16, J22)
articles.abstract_cn: 美国女性的劳动力参与率在1990年代中期之前迅速上升，之后趋于平稳。我通过一个包含性别差异的定量模型来考察这一趋势变化对总体商业周期的影响。我表明，女性参与率的上升在“大缓和”时期发挥了重要作用，而不考虑性别差异会导致对其原因的推断错误。随后女性参与率的放缓在无就业复苏中发挥了重要作用，并减少了扩张期的总工时和产出增长，恶化了美国的总体经济表现。（JEL E13, E23, E24, E32, J16, J22）

articles.title_en: Market Segmentation and International Bond Prices: The Role of ECB Asset Purchases
articles.title_cn: 市场分割与国际债券价格：欧洲央行资产购买的作用
articles.abstract_en: We estimate euro-dollar yields differences, hedged and unhedged, with euro area confidential corporate bond holdings data. We find that euro yields significantly decline relative to dollar yields—more for securities in the portfolios of investors that prefer euro securities and securities eligible for the European Central Bank asset purchase programs. We then test and uncover a negative relation between the estimated yields differentials and purchases at the aggregate and firm level—stronger for long-term securities and those held by investors with a euro-denomination preference. Evidence supports a local supply and duration extraction channel instead of a pure demand channel. (JEL E43, E58, F31, G12, G15, G20)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用欧元区机密公司债券持有数据，估计了欧元与美元收益率差异，包括对冲和未对冲的情况。我们发现，欧元收益率相对于美元收益率显著下降——对于偏好欧元证券的投资者投资组合中的证券以及符合欧洲央行资产购买计划条件的证券，下降幅度更大。然后，我们检验并发现了估计的收益率差异与总体和公司层面的购买之间存在负相关关系——对于长期证券和由具有欧元计价偏好的投资者持有的证券，这种关系更强。证据支持本地供给和久期提取渠道，而非纯粹的需求渠道。（JEL E43, E58, F31, G12, G15, G20）
